candidates.change_summary: Change the require that each low-level call succeeded to instead allow failures and treat them as non-fatal (remove require around _s), so transfer can return true even if some calls revert internally, altering the returned boolean when original would revert or succeed differently.
Relax the validAddress modifier to allow address(0x0) (remove that require), so calls with zero address pass validation and may change return behavior when contract_address is zero.

Replace the external call to use msg.sender and tos[i] swapped in order (calling transferFrom(msg.sender, tos[i], vs[i]) -> transferFrom(tos[i], msg.sender, vs[i])) which changes which address is treated as the recipient/sender by the target contract.
Modify the validAddress modifier to allow the zero address by removing the require that blocks address(0), which can change behavior when contract_address is zero.
